audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed across layers. Full-layer phases[].side read Qiyana/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Orianna - including level 1, which the full layer gave to Qiyana and the content layer gave to Orianna.
audit.why: The content layer matches the packet levelChart. At level 1 Qiyana has a 525-range Q and no Audacity, so Orianna out-ranges her outright; levels 4-5 through first item are hers because a 650-range Audacity into an element combo takes a dashless mage's whole bar, and Supreme Display of Talent turns any wall into a 120s stun; two-plus items return to Orianna once Zhonya's covers the one window and Shockwave decides grouped fights.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content values with ratings 7/5/5/3/3/3/7, every moved why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.why: The spike sequence is right and unusually well grounded already: her level 3-5 Audacity-plus-element window, her level 6 terrain ultimate, her first-item lethality execute, and Orianna's Zhonya's-plus-second-item flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all, and the page never named the one number that decides every forward step: Audacity's cooldown.
audit.why: Audacity is 11/10/9/8/7 at 650 range and is her only committed gap-close onto you; Terrashape is a 7s reposition that enchants the weapon; the Q is 7s at 525 range; the ultimate is a flat 120s and requires terrain or an element to detonate. That last point is why warding walls and brush is a mechanical answer rather than general advice.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0..2], dontsFull[0..2] and the moved whys now carry 11s, 7s, 650 range and 120s.
sources: brief enemyKit R text and terrain flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-three misgendering findings - Qiyana called he/his/him across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, six phases whys, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, five dos/donts fields and six report entries - plus two copy-paste bleeds and an unsupported "fifteen-second" window in dosFull[2].d.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists qiyana as female. The fifteen-second figure appears nowhere in her kit; Audacity is 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d replaced with kit-grounded bodies matching their titles; dosFull[2].d corrected to 11 seconds.

notes: Cross-layer chart disagreement on rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 - including level 1, where the full layer credited Qiyana and the content layer credited Orianna. Full layer moved onto the content layer, which the packet levelChart matches. No paired win[N] edits are proposed because win[N] already holds the correct value on disk. The existing content mentions Qiyana W "camouflage" and a "brush element"; Riot's W text in the kit file says only that she dashes and enchants her weapon, with no camouflage, so those claims were left untouched rather than either repeating or deleting them - see unverified. report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t and report[11].t also carry misgendered pronouns but duplicate winCon, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave and the donts titles this proposal already rewrites; they were left rather than spending report scope on four duplicate rewrites, and need a follow-up pronoun pass if the applier does not propagate.
